# yellowdog_keyring (Resource)

Manages a keyring.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A keyring holds the credentials -- cloud provider accounts, instance logins,
# storage keys -- that compute source templates refer to as
# "<keyring name>/<credential name>".
resource "yellowdog_keyring" "example" {
  name        = "example-keyring"
  description = "Cloud provider credentials managed by Terraform"
}

# The keyring password is returned only once, when the keyring is created.
output "example_keyring_password" {
  value     = yellowdog_keyring.example.keyring_password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `keyring_password` (String, Sensitive) The keyring's password (only returned by the API at creation time)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the keyring's name or its YDID; the id recorded in state is
# always the YDID. keyring_password is null after import, as the API returns it
# only when the keyring is created.
terraform import yellowdog_keyring.example example-keyring
```
